title: Imbroglio of the self
lines: Shadows cast on cave walls,
Imprinting scurrilous insecurity,
You compensate it with servility,
To the sheep in wolf's clothing, when it calls.
For all a god and all your prayers can do,
You bleed with the spears of asperity intact,
Inebriated in delusions debilitating the fact,
That those haciendas you built couldn't domesticate you,
No self, No melancholy, No worth, No euphoria,
Intrinsic journey of the self,
Don't bury the hatchet, Burn the shelf,
Renounce fantasy, and welcome budding paranoia.

title: Baptism
lines: Bolstering the wailing cries of widowed ambitions in the grander scheme,
Anxiety is rolling off the lips of angsty adolescents quoting messiahs,
Piss problems away after salting the rims subsequently sipping on skits,
Tip-toeing on those shards of shattered dreams,
Impeach your lust for vengeance vouching for the abyss it is,
a whole generation of misfits wallowing in self-pity,
Masochistic malevolent exterior to protect your damaged masculinity.

title: Taboo
lines: Toast to the tyrannical war inside wouldn't sate,
A pacifist's promise won't hold out till my liver's death date,
Beseech bulimia to puke out the melancholy within,
On that thin line like a funambulist hoping I don't go down the road of insanity spiralin',
Orthodox traditions are a fallacy to human nature. Gregarious sheeps following trends hypnotized by pastors.

title: Exist
lines: Spastic proclamations of vapid voluble belittling,
Falling fast into a black cesspool couldn't conquer,
Thoughts piling up nibbling away at my conscience crumbling,
A lanky lachrymose vacillating vivaciously in a corner,
Hounding hoaxes persevering in the pursuit of prolific prunes gone missing,
Mind bleeding words through ink inevitably a crusader,
Moon blooms in trepidation of the dawning realization of existence,
Blood dripping off the corpses reaching out as I stumble further

title: Satanic Sabbatical
lines: Skimpy truth scrambling off sullied soliloquies,
With that derogatory draped tongue sloshed,
Stumbling through the stairway to salvation,
Their eyes gleam an ephemeral blaze,
Burned out with worries betwixt lone nights and blurry benders,
Wondering if the things happened, pave a path for the next,
Recognition plagued by tattoos of affiliation,
Hacienda of hallucinations masking mixed exasperations,
Wondering if a sweatshirt would weather the cold,
Would a life without meaning be so cruel,
As to disband hoaxes with a rosy smile,
Painted on the face of faceless kin,
Skimpy truth scrambling off sullied soliloquies,
With that derogatory draped tongue sloshed.

title: Didactic Decadence
lines: I preach the vermin's sermon,
You sell societal remedies under the guise of ignorance,
Redistributing stories to add to your credence,
Prancin' proud, praying of persecuted panacea,
A passionate parable on the masses' case,
As incurable as your mental decrement,
The wolf who cried sheep, merrily,
Mesmerized in the drug of hope,
For what can one do to cope,
Idyllic blissful bastards gulping gluttony.

title: Fraternizing Fool
lines: Counting nickels with Nicholas Cage mesmerized in monotony,
Got dreams to sell, soliciting hope for the yielding youth,
Young enough to get your pastor droolin' in debilitating agony,
Whisperin' wails, exasperated exclamations masking the truth?
Heart bleeding words wedged in the batter of begrudging bakery,
Are affiliations attributed to the cornucopia of cuts on your wrist?
Sweaty, sleepless sheep ran astray for vivisection of melancholy,
Drifting in a desolated dystopia only to be gutted down with brute,
Potency as blood spills, stumbling, scrambling basked in glory.

title: Haze
lines: Blood on my feet, leaving bloody footprints,
On my trail behind, crevices carved on the tar roads,
Dazed when I see the carcass of the copulated coveted,
Iconoclasm eclipsed dreams, crescent feigns beauty,
Mind an unadulterated lens, concocting cocktails in the darkest corners.

title: Plastic Cleopatra
lines: Face off the pavement, brush the incumbent dust off,
Stuck in the broiling tar pit, Cemented in exonerated expressions,
Specters of speculated sorrow, dance in mortified melancholy,
Atop the skid marks serpentine, turgid with tempest trickling from burnt tires,
Stuck in the broiling tar pit, Cemented in exonerated expressions.
Severed heads stocked up, on the fireplace smothered in smoke,
Choked with the encumbrance, wheezing in murky waters,
Shadows cast on fractured paths, treaded and ended with dusk,
Dearth of life, desultory, desiccated, asphyxiating aphorism,
Choked with encumbrance, wheezing in murky waters.

title: Pagan Parakeet
lines: Stretch the skin off my bone, stripped to servile angst,
Dawdling in this wax symposium, prevaricating the impending flame
Lit on the convivial chandelier, trickling away amidst ameliorated fantasy,
Digs roots deep, melting away unctuously unperturbed.
Puddles of putrid heat, weld their feet into the collapsing catastrophe,
The fatality elicit, under futile felicitation shone by firebrands
as speculative garrulity entrenched, wax waned,
encumbering masses onto inebriated masses, laced with
poison;
Illumination on the stoic visage, frozen in hazes of past,
inclement claws cave their way in as shadows turn somber,
The catatonic conundrum collapses, the chandelier lights
a bonfire, devoid of gasps and screams, they wilt away.

title: Penitentiary Nights
lines: Pestilential penitentiary with moss-covered walls,
Fortnightly fervent dreams left him feverish,
Moonlight shone pale on pests scampering to defiant calls
on those rigid walls; Held constrained by shackles martinetish,
Desolate depravity clasped wrists cold, shimmering pale under moonlit hegemony,
Contemplating in constituted reform, Fever dreams of procuring poisoned prunes,
Hues of blue and white painted onto the prisoner, bold and raw disconnect,
A servitude to starvation with a glutton for guile, slow dancing to the testimony,
Screams rose between the walls, the room lit up with the pity of a thousand moons,
Squinting eyes; he turned to see the shackles he held on to, couldn’t hold him bereft.

title: Dysphoria
lines: These shoulders are not for you to rest your head on,
eschewed altruism’s spawn whispering on either side,
Wasting away with each breath that I take, desperate
gasp reach my hand out, grasped in a quicksand,
Sand clasped in hand, slipping away into abandonment of light.
Smothered by sand, soothed by the embrace, goading glimpses,
sneeze and cough then wheeze, asphyxiating agony,
Desiccated tongue devoured, eyes bludgeoned
cannot see the abyss of depravity; Mirrored in the mesmerizing
struggle, the last fits of the carnal fight lost and submerged.
Faded into sand, return to the monotony,
Slumber midst rocks and of those before, hand
raised to the elixir of hope, life drenched out,
Corpses carved into the sand the effigies of conquest,
Lost and lost, in this disorienting dream.

title: Messiah
lines: Swayed to the whims and wishes of the tides of times,
One hand raised to the sky, the other at sea’s behest,
Clinging to this scrawny scrap, the sun beating down,
Glistening apparitions of the past lurking about, take a swig
Of this slice of life, the belligerent testimony of the soulless
with their tongues cut out, blood on the sickles you bind them to,
Drenched with sweat, they lost destiny’s grace as we fall to
our knees and bow to our gods, the light flickering away till hollow
Spheres stare back into the depths of your psyche, eyes
peeling away at the sight of your thought, in the midst of a
mid-spring storm, the eye of the hurricane blinks away raining
stones at the feet of their masters.

title: Fervour
lines: The shovel hits the ground, the crypt virgin in its wake,
Like a moth to that flame, hit the shovel on the grave,
Eyes mesmerized in the gray, drab destitute they lay,
Flinging dirt over the shoulder, time's tides washing over,
Promises kept vacant in desolate glances, exchanged with
Compunction, mediated through trembles of tumult,
A butterfly tantalized in trances of tracing circles,
The clank of metal on wood freed them of their
behest, the coffin uncovered the face of solipsism.

title: Solitary cemetery
lines: Thickets of trepidation weeded this barren bog,
Interspersed with seedlings of apprehension,
Barefoot on this travesty trembling,
Step into bliss dragging the stone shackled to his foot,
Bloody feet fertilizing the meadow of marauders.
Yellow to red the meadow sprout into life,
The path lay ahead from the bodies paved,
Howling maniacally dragging the stone with each step,
Each grown and moan ringing out ears,
Tranquil eyes fixated on the throne.
The bodies mutilated, amputated,
Eyes hollow whites staring back in collective suffering,
Gaping mouth stitched muffled whimpers, hands stretched to the
throne no fingers to count, the lashes led to the red road,
Eyes white, scream stitched, as he collapses on the throne.

title: Mirror
lines: Stealing glances at the mirror, couldn't recognize the
Sculptor’s work, poignant in its ephemera,
Divine retribution inundating the abyss, close my eyes,
Steal a moment with it all, choked in dissociation.
Walls closing in, frozen in dysphoria,
Poised callous, trimmed fingernails bleed,  writing
eulogies on the walls only to be devoured,
Slipping past, passing away at the precipice.
Eye pleads fear, mind seeks solace,
Thrown from one universe to the other, trapped in
a loop of playing the marionette and maestro,
Pray to the bodies, piled up on the mantle.

title: Mental Meth
lines: I pedaled to perplexed paranoia, to persecute people,
Couldn't split the last plate, was carrying too much baggage,
Stack the broken furniture fervent in feverish desire,
Reach the ceiling only to caress the bloodstains,
Why did nobody say I was dreaming?
Drenched in mud, why were you hesitating?
Have you been faking the whole time?
Back alley penurious, don't touch the algae,
Palace's where the pigs stay, shackled by sties,
Butterflies babble in innocuous indemnification,
Bitter to the touch, wriggling till my wings clip off,
Crimson caveats carving away with the lashes to the back,
Peace to make with the sacrificial lamb.

title: Night Guillotine
lines: Last breath at the stroke of midnight,
Christened with the holy water of indifference,
Spit into the predatory snake pit, rebirthed from the
Venomous vicissitudes, scars sculpted from the carcasses
of culminating contemplation, ritualistic blood-smeared
on firebrands pulling the strings of the unborn,
Statues casting anachronistic shadows, mesmerizing zealots
chanting faded interpretations, ever so softly entrenched in the psyche,
Hesitate and mediate till the congregation is buried, semblance of wisps
shape up in a carousel of screams, lights frantically flickering,
the deafening scream echoes out, Suicide costs more than blood
and broken bones, born a saint bled out a sinner,
Trapped in the vestibule of vindication, between the elevator to
ecstasy and the doorway to deprivation, castle of glass shatters not at the
onslaught of stones, It bleeds quick in the furnace of futility,
Widowed innocence’s wizened wails, weathered the effigy aplenty,
Cacophony of the tipping scales rung out coalesced with the shattering,
The crescendo died out, silence conquered the tides of glass.

title: Metamorphosis
lines: Philosophizing in anguished atonement,
The surreptitious snake coils onto conscience,
Arrested development in capsized chivalry,
Knight in shining armor to the damsel,
Only the armor bears hollow and the damsel
Reaffirmed devoid of necessity, kettles and teapots clatter not;
Eyes covered in soot Sobre in sunlight,
Euphoria dancing in masquerading melancholy,
Tip-toeing in angsty charlatanism.

title: Claustrophobia
lines: Apprehension apprehended, monstrosity runs rampant,
Desolate, ravaged these inklings bear no fruit,
Genocide’s genesis shone light, dissociation deepening,
Pontificating the transformation, wake up panting at the sight,
A black sea, indifferent, the serenity of silence,
The fall makes no sound, encumbered by tranquility,
Drowning in drawn fantasies, disillusioned delusions,
Volition to breathe dissipated at the bottom of the sea.
Stagnation stipulated, suspended in somber serenity,
Head bowed, pray to the predators of bureaucracy,
Eyes in subservience to the limbo of lights,
Nostalgia nascent in the reflections of rumination.

title: Tears
lines: Painted on the face, the tributaries of turmoil,
Bloated veins, busted on broken dreams,
Vicissitudes shook to the core,
Hand on my heart, the cross to die,
Babble like a sheep, hungry like a wolf,
Weeping willows ache, whistling out,
Wear my face, bear it on your borrowed visage,
Politicking with pyrotechnics, amber ashes rain,
Apropos to nothing, that has all laid in,
Bloodcurdling screeches ring out, accommodating apprehension,
The symphony of sirens, bodies left vacant,
Smile in solemn silence.

title: Cranial confounding
lines: Head rocked back into the ephemeral void,
Jerk back when palpitations palpable, echo inside,
Shut the visage of the vixen outside,
Shrug sweat, slugging like parched parsimony.
The face of equanimity, fracturing fixated facade,
Fallacious frolicking, fervent fever took me,
Fucking your face up, fantasies fruitful only in need,
Fled, the fire to fizzle out, Flame raging bequeathed.
Solstice of sanctimony sinned in streams,
Burgeoning, the shadow of doubt cannot cease,
Silhouette of reason, recurring, relegating, replenishing,
A wink of respite, despite the despise of bloodshed.

title: Hexed Curse
lines: Lost in an imbroglio of complexes, loyalties, and impulses,
Noise filling the void up, encumbrance of emotional intricacy,
Presence euphoric, drowning in debilitation, showed up at my door,
Demarcate my psychological efficacy, philosophical effrontery,
You part these lines, depth shallow when I dip my feet in,
It’s sliding away, probity promises made at the stroke of sobriety,
Addiction creeping up, wistful weeks pass, jealousy crept up,
Cold shoulders, feigning in the twilight, moonlit melancholy.
At the break of dawn, I woke up from a dream, gasping for breath,
inebriated in my guilt, a true moment in this crevice of a journey,
at the break of respite, I break off my escapist engagement,
The juxtaposition, facing the music, tributaries tumbled down,
Caught up in a drug-fueled haze, one addiction for another?
I close my eyes to take a leap of faith, open my eyes in the midst of a hurricane,
Butterflies and blood, eyes bludgeoned, the world turned.
Another promise of longevity, aghast by the wisps of woe,
You lend a hand to me, share your warmth, suppressed dependence,
All in vain, the drug of replication, the veil of love,
Could not see, the bard rose to the call of sunshine,
Stuffing my past into decrepit upholstery, the bolts coming loose,
Turn a blind eye, caterpillar into the cocoon, asphyxiate in aspersions,
Retaliate in kind, terror reigns, recoil with hard-headed doctrinaire,
Metamorphosis manifests in unadulterated rage, swallow my words.

title: Hazed eclipse
lines: Inebriated in nostalgia, lust, and thought, psychedelics vibrant,
Myriad of memories interwoven in the stitched state of serenity,
Polemic, slander inundate thy presence, presence of mind fractured,
Cesspool of psychological warfares, intertwined with baffled banter,
Paranoia, proclivity, prevarication to the proposed prophecy,
Floating on the surface, dip my feet, dabble in underlying significance,
Narcolepsy knocking and beckoning, nights lived in hedonistic voids,
The troll got word, in the next chapter he babbled, whined, and crooned.
Burst out in vigorous vehemence, all frustrations focused on the weasel,
The warble of a smitten knight, crushed the larynx, tossed aside,
The jury came to be, snickering and sniding at each remark,
The troll planted seeds, aggravated by my tumultuous tirades,
Rained down, started off bold and braven, spat at and depraved,
Witnesses were called and the name was cleared, the smitten troll
smug in his holy knightedness cried away bawling at my feet,
In a moment of weakness, I forgave as he bawled away, remiss in his loss.
Frustrations flew away, yet the void of validation led to deprivation,
Who was the fox and who was the crane? Whose ear was corrupted?
Icarus’ wings took him to the sun, final moments in debilitation,
At least he died chasing his beacon, on the other hand,
Son of the sun relegated to insecurity at the depths of loneliness,
An eye vigilant to the stones thrown at his bruised shackles,
Shivering in desperate desolation, impulses only to be fed,
Self-reflection at the world’s edge, why do I feel great in your absence?

title: Rock-bottom
lines: Restless nights, caught up in a sacred space, alienating reality,
Violence, protest, or lachrymosity? Hands did not cease tremors,
the entanglement of emotions choking me out,
Paid no heed until one midnight, where the streams no drought could stop,
Answered the call of the nurturer once was, gave false hope in misunderstood musings,
The shadow of doubt embraced me, did not preach but remarked,
With each step and word that fell out of each soliloquy, the python intertwined,
Dreams and fables of what once was, held me in its grasp and a sigh of relief escaped my lips.
My knees fell, the truth, only indifference to answer, wide-eyed wonder,
Flirting with deceit, dichotomy, and hypocrisy, slow dancing with second chances,
The deceit continued and the facade relished, never was love, a daydream,
The bard deceased at nightfall stars sucking out oxygen,
Groveling at the feet of what was promised once, illusory illumination,
Desperation, perspiration in precipitation, the last call announced,
Led astray, paths broke apart after lies revealed, heralded hypocrisy,
Thrown into the abyss, the troll barged in, the gates of sin parted.
Hurled deeper, mind spiraling, kaleidoscopic swings betwixt possibilities,
More chaos, feelings run dry as impulses shone bright, swayed by mixed signals, Exasperations and aspersions, drowned in the cocktail of ambition and image,
Traversing the thickets, cut up, sliced open, festering wounds on the summer solstice,
The spurious definitions of power and masculinity, fostering reasons to lash out,
Bludgeoned me against those noxious thorns, When will this dream end?
Realization dawned at the apotheosis, guilt disavowed an eye for an eye,
In prescient prognosis all will be dust, entangling the imbroglio.

title: The Lover
lines: The hand that caressed, strangled the stimulus set,
Coiled back and spit venom, skinned game, slung back as a trophy,
Trepidation tumbled through, minions miming haphazard renditions,
Water in the eyes, a whole generation rattled, more spears of
Acerbic assaults dipped in surreptitious schemes, the puppet master
Traumatized, but the puppet beseeched, drowned in the tears of intoxication,
The hand that held, cut up and bruised, the marks on all our arms,
Like a cult of stained repressions, soliloquized in blood.
The puppet’s preachings are pervasive and paramount,
Elucidating elusive exclamations, truth muddled, broken, spread,
The hand that reached out, bit it with compunction compulsive,
The hand that fed, could not sate the rancorous avarice,
The hand that punished, reached out from the apotheosis,
Downpour of destitution, the phoenix fizzled to ashes,
Introspection, quizzical whims watered down, disposition disparaged,
Visage submerged in the depths of conscientious assimilation.
Leash on that spiraling sycophant, reason to conquer,
Never saw the road paved out, four butterflies perched upon my shoulder,
Perspective shifted, accordance to the beacon beckoning,
Had the last supper, made my peace, regret cutaway in blood and flesh,
The path paved beckoned for the sound of footsteps on gravel,
Lachrymosity washed away with wine and merry, animosity patched,
Digressions drowned out as the first rays of sunlight hit the pavement,
I peered at the edge of the horizon, took one last look at the maze, and moved.

title: Validation
lines: Pay no heed to the foul, vile beast spewing gibberish gallantly,
Her minions to heed, fantasizing heroism in piss-stained garb,
Called me a blessing, now mouth the false gospel in laced lisps,
Gasps and groans, wooden stake to suffice, impaled in implication,
Labeled, lauded, and stowed to the flames, no ear to validate,
Eyes that saw, bleed lecherous didacticism, added fuel to the fire
Devil incarnate, until all you could see, was the carcass of ramifications,
Only silence to soothe the burns, broiling baroque barrages.
Truth true to the testimony preached, heard and felt,
Not for the reasons spewed by the hand that fit the puppet,
Ventriloquism not validated, vandalized walls stained the streets,
No jury to bear, no ear to hear, no warmth to sate,
Splashed away with comments, slander I did not heed,
Did not burn the hand that set it aflame, did not reveal the pages written,
Feign niceties, did present personal afflictions on stone,
For the ones that listened, how else to retaliate the obloquy made obsolete,
Struck when the iron hot, deformed, demented displays,
Lobbying bannermen, lobbied masses misled by misconstructions,
No clearance of name, only shame to gluttonize, stuff down malleable throats,
In clear conscience I preach, if this is tantamount to the dream,
Burn and rot in despicable destitution, you firebrands of fallacy,
Flabbergasted by the hypocrisy, drown in your desperation, never to fill the void,
Put me through the path of mandated masked memories, Threw the facade,
Illiterate in the light, dumbfounded and befuddled, reduced to rubble.

title: Final word
lines: No validation so sanctimonious to leave what I am,
True to what I had and will have, I became,
Hags haggling over rotten rabble, only to be left to burn,
See me as I spread my decrepit wings with a sly smile,
Burn with your ones in the symposium of semblances,
You’re not what you show yourself to be, flip the mirror,
Look at yourself, look at your wretched wrecked will,
Succumb to your limbo of deprecation, slow dance on the edge.
No one entangles the maze, the displays officious,
Revel in the discrete packets of confounded cumulations,
Masks broken only I could see, neutral in your insularity,
Friends of polarities so couldn’t stand with, kneel and kiss illusory fables,
Inebriated hypocrites, shit, who isn’t? A moment of weakness,
The shade of equanimity reclaimed, conquer while you melt into oblivion,
Irrational frenzy restrained by self-reflection, hide behind broken masks,
Running to redeem, inconsequential weeds only to be stampeded.
Paint painful pictures, precocious perceptibility, different iterations,
Laugh in your sacred cubicles of economy, ignore the calls to reality,
How much more for that perceived paradise of days past and to come?
Spent efforts, dried tears, and fragmented feelings again,
How do I know if I’m not where I started? Reflect on your visages,
Smile those empty smiles, faces soon dissipate to memories,
Past, present is it any different or just circumstantial codification,
Hope runs, so do I, long as the feet not leave the earth that birthed.

title: Water hose
lines: Broken shoes slip off, scabbed feet,
Don't stumble through the swamp,
No sun to impassion, swans sing goodbyes,
Tangled in intertwined vines, salt taxes,
Rocking back and forth in the confounding cradle; the shore plain to see,
No equanimity, where did the thirst for triumph dry out?
In the wells of whispered exaggerations,
No cries heard over the mongering mortalities,
Teetering on a thin line, apathy nibbling away,
Give up and fall off the darkness to take.

title: Child's play
lines: Taking the quicksand ride to my ways,
Was always stuck and dreaming of escape,
In the long run, no royal homages pay,
Only cascades of remains to drape,
Parched for succulents, see the heydays,
Many a dream the departed scourge of the land draped.
The vulture gazes, perched upon the corpse,
Cackles in symbiotic connotations, clangor concurrent to clarity,
The emergence of nascent, numb, naive, nostalgic hopes,
Crushed under the unrelenting chaos of parity,
Nowhere to go in Ozymandias maze of the lachrymose,
Cyclic storms recurrent with waves of aridity.

title: Blank faces
lines: Hungry, glazed over, insomniac, toe-to-toe,
Tucked away behind the mask of hollow eyes,
Knitted eyebrows, with each crack, the voice silenced screeches,
Ink runs dry, the mind in dumbfounded agony,
Articulate takedowns of aphorisms dispelled,
Take a deep breath, and sigh out loud, play some tunes,
Dance to others, strung away by hopes and misled by potential,
Flickering lights leave bliss blind, trepidation turbulent,
Blank faces at what cost, feeling pumped out,
Succumb to sedated silences, expressed resentment,
Caged in, senile but infertile, vacant woes for verbosity,
Perplexing perfection that earlier petrified, reduced to rambling reluctance,
Archetypes, psychological confluences, framed despairs,
Listed out, and eulogized on a court of jovially juxtaposed juveniles.

title: Discombobulated discord
lines: Familial frankness, drunken stupors, and cigarette ash,
Wheeze, cough, repeat, chase the taboo,
Grasp it, diversify, deepen, dread, regret, exhaust,
A moment of respite, reflection, and recompense,
Jerked away by fantasies fabricated in that sadistic sect,
Puddles of perspiration drowned in lust, faked fervor,
Forged love in rampant panic, asymptomatic to the act.
Loose-tongued lies slip off the lips, spit in the sink,
Tying the noose to my nose, with bated breath,
See the expulsion of the masses, excretions of extrapolation,
What mortality can grace this cesspool of convolutions?
A tug of ambiguity between fantasy and true nature,
Is it all pretense, our dedicated diligence to decency?
Or are we monopolizing a set of woeful contradictions?

title: Extremities
lines: Salivating secretions of solace-laced soliloquies,
Only at precipitation at the precipice of a paranoid beckoning,
What’s next, an indulgence laced into the clockwork periodic,
Chasing, gnawing, sucking, moaning in that puzzling prerogative?
Defined by boredom, sculpted by perversion,
Corroborated by humanity, extrapolated as deviance,
What’s next, persevering insomnia to fuel hysterical outbursts,
The only solace to achieve through tortured trials.

title: Amoral Asphyxiation
lines: Twilight in your eye, a daydream for me,
Wanted to end your life, tugging me away,
Drive us to insanity, this dizzying dally,
Plead me to take your breath, not your life,
Hands wane strength, eyes glisten prescience,
Sacrificed yourself for the semblance,
For feverish dalliance danced at dusk,
The sacrificial lamb bled not, only tortured,
Trepidation crept up, histrionics flare,
Embers of rage rampant, cries and wails,
Pouring out like the pus on your blister,
Exaggerations embark, impatience croons,
Miserably dreaming of legal union, best memories,
Made with you, letting go garrulous gripes,
Sleepless nights, deplorable angst,
The worst of it yet to come, nocturnal visions of those nights,
Comes and goes, the feelings of hysteria, delusion,
One last time, the scent of skin on skin,
The touch of madness forgone, only glimpses,
Caress wounds to heal in heated haughtiness,
Hold your breath, to breathe life,
Taste it on your conscience, clotted clemency,
Hand let go not to hurt, but you coddle pain,
Hit you in whispers of waxing climaxes,
Ambiguity crept in hollowed out silences,
Dried out wails of the morning, tire mistaken,
Push your buttons, pain and pleasure,
Head rocked back with each push,
The fire rampant in remembrances.

title: Gorging masochism
lines: Succumb to gluttony, eyes dried out,
Hollowed inside with overindulgent ecstasy,
Sacrifices and toils, accompanied inadvertently,
Regrets and stress welling up, up to the neck,
Esophagus dried, barren and brushed away,
Feel something other than a void or abyss,
Cold hands clasped, stealing my breath,
Oxygenated conscience, harping trumpets,
Turbulent waters ahead, going against the tides,
Wash, scrub, sponge off the filth coated on,
Skin-deep malevolence motivates masses,
Gravity pulls apart crept up dreams,
In crevices of proclivity, protrudes probation,
Who are you proving what to?
Medications and sensations to fill up with,
This tireless tirade wanted and wasted,
Superstars fizzled out in a flash of light,
Gone off at the wrong time, only a speck of dust,
Misplaced and lost in this dystopian dichotomy.

title: Acceptance apologia
lines: Layering lamentations, hinder the winter,
Exonerating medication usage, hereafter,
No overflowing ripples of paranoia, sweat profuse,
Veronal overdose, dosing off murders,
Naked truths, naked vulnerabilities,
Shared in yawns of crevices in camaraderie,
Tears at the party, the light flashing,
Bouncing, bubbling champagne, lights flickering,
Flipping pills and drinks, drown in tears,
And cries of help called out in desperate doorways,
Dabble with deprecation, insomnia ablaze,
Cadging lost prerogatives, perplexed,
Lascivious laments leaking in terror's threat,
Tower of semblance reduced to rubble,
Rebel against the rage, the rampant reigns,
Terror, jittering, malice paint the field red,
Bone marrow adulterated the assembly feigned,
The fever grips the throat in moans and whispers,
Facetious fantasizing, avenues tortuous,
Alacrity not to greet, tumult with open arms.

title: Tears and choices
lines: Fucked up and crumbling, denied solidity of stolidity,
Pitying patrons toss charity in mongering buckets,
Clattering, convulsing cacophony of cries,
Not chosen over, abandoned and disbanded,
No escapades tantamount scars, scathing fortnightly,
Severs the appendices, veneers vivacity,
Eyes to your feet, can't see where I stand,
She wails and cries, trampled by choice,
She tosses and turns, tears cosset not,
Wondering what voids supplanted the ones she couldn't fill,
Planting verisimilitude into limbic loops,
Divulge into the differences, digressing revelations,
While the hippocampus hampers, restraining,
Flashbacks behind that impassive countenance,
Lifeless tears stream down, encase shared life,
Understanding feigned, melting bowl of red herrings,
Ambiguity adroitly applied to innocuous inquisition,
She wails and cries, trampled by choice,
She tosses and turns, tears cosset not,
Wondering what voids supplanted the ones she couldn't fill.

title: The first step
lines: Suffering's a stepping stone,
Beautification of masochism in her eyes,
Traversing my effigies showcased alone,
Discombobulated in fantasized lies,
Inebriated day to day, strung along.
Only life and death to account,
Sly indulgence in medicated fervor,
Meditating maligned, equanimity's frown,
First a dream, then a kiss, then a precursor,
Solitude's nothing to denounce.
The path laid out in serpentine sewers,
Destitute, despondent, and depraved,
Ineptitude to embrace, mauled by mewlers,
He said, "Masculinity merges, bereaved,"
She said, "Your eyes tremble but the tear withers."

title: Debilitated sermon
lines: Whispered confessions in Eastside,
I only feel connection when inebriated,
How much longer till I let it subside?
I only like you in the shadows of faded,
Craving the sympathy I don't have on offer,
Why do I try, and when will I know?
Opened a Pandora's box with all I have in coffeurs,
Self-harm subsidy, only subtly grow,
Whispered confessions in Eastside,
Cry to myself, but there's people to hear,
Regret and escapism to bide,
Quick, can you buy me a beer?
Lungs the last resort, who to absolve?
How much longer till you're sober, when will it pain?
Company's the problem and the resolve,
Feign indifference, the face waxes in vain.

title: Listen less
lines: Relocate polarities, helpless in despair,
Questioning quests quench ash's thirst,
Inebriated confessions whispered in
Silences, shared in laughable retrospect,
Breathe in, try temperance with temper,
Failure fathoms, festers, fosters,
Hold back tears, react in flippant facades,
Solace in company, escapism to indulge,
An addiction, no conundrum,

title: Replicable cycles
lines: Suffering's a stepping stone,
Beautification of masochism in her eyes,
Traversing my effigies showcased alone,
Discombobulated in fantasized lies,
Inebriated day to day, strung along.
Only life and death to account,
Sly indulgence in medicated fervour,
Meditating maligned, equanimity's frown,
First a dream, then a kiss, then a precursor,
Solitude's nothing to denounce.
The path laid out in serpentile sewers,
Destitute, despondent, and depraved,
Ineptitude to embrace, mauled by mewlers,
He said, "Masculinity merges, bereaved,"
She said, "Your eyes tremble but the tear withers."

title: Struggle
lines: Bicker, babble, bark and burgeon,
True essence of nature revealed,
Compassion not acerbic accompaniment,
Breathe and heave, calamity disrupts,
Tides of impermanence wash over,
Tributaries dissipate in dissected identities,
Look through, don’t see, look away,
Lava discriminates not what is buried,
Ash on the shores, flowing through the banks,
Heaven and earth in the steamy downpour,
Each breath renewed, potent proclamation,
Estimate and fail, flippant and fruitful,
Threading realizations reverberating,
Regressing river twists and turns,
No respite on the shore, jump in and let go.

title: Leviathan
lines: Ways susceptible to philosophical challenge,
With the sands of time in the hourglass,
Sink don’t stand, think without predilection,
Erect the statue of solipsism, helpless,
Sand slips through, let go, it’s the end.
The present elicits impulsively restrained,
The master leads not at the fore,
Brimming yet empty, lurking letters
flash epiphany and aphorism,
Meaningless, full of life, and dead.
Instinctually intellectual, firing synapses,
Silence and satisfaction beckon through reflections,
Vicariously living the egotistical shallow,
Swim but drown, the tides twisting and turning,
Froth, salt, water and sand but stitches and stones.

title: Path to the summit
lines: Summit submerged in self’s strive,
Unmotivated and bulging, looming clouds
Surround, stricken with immovable perplexity,
Call out to the abyss, stare into it,
Nothing calls back, just reflected expectation,
Seek out the wise and unlearned,
Sagacity perennial in segmented windows
Of solace in the right light, seeking
And hiding midst shadows cast in
Nature’s embrace, don’t squint,
Leap of faith and a blurred haze,
Breathe inner quietude, artistry in carved
Caricatures of the cumbersome climb,
Anchor here, turbulence inevitable,
Skirt directed misguidance, give in to it.

title: Second death
lines: No recognition in the visage of self,
Proclaim insignificance, dogging fog,
Clarity disperses, blinding white spark,
No cause of import, ambition severs all,
A fog of incense, futility to see through,
See what your eyes can, not what to disperse,
Heavy breaths and solemn sorrow spills,
Self inflicted spirit’s disruption to ostracize,
A long, lone road with a slight chance of rain,
Renewed and unearthed, muddy and writhing,
Kindness kindling within, call out cumbersome.

title: Don’t know how to act
lines: Eyes with incendiary gleam, lost in translation,
Embers of mesmerization flickering,
Recollections of lives lived past, tremors,
Usurped by groundbreaking realizations
Of the beauty of life, her and possibility,
Bodies burn on throes of passion,
Lost fires reignite in retrospective fragments,
Personification of precarious perfection,
Walking world of wit and serpentine elegance,
Bled my heart out on the beach,
Mountains traveled, experiences fathomed,
Exchanges brewed in babbling brevity,
Ongoing waves of tumult, but anchored
Through her resilience refused to resign,
Close my eyes and yearn your refuge,
Toss and tussle, dread and yearn,
Impulses overdrive, nauseous, head turning,
Soothe the tears, stagnant solidarity,
Steady the hand, egotistic ogling,
Shelter serendipitous in your arms.

title: Death bed
lines: On the brink of tears, unfazed, still life
To gaze at, the irreducible magic ignited,
Canopy of emotions only thoughts to provoke,
Deaf, dumb and blind to feel the depth,
Impulses beating like heartache, brows
Contracting, beating, infuriating masochism,
Laughing, scoffing, scathing secrets of self,
What to see, in this tumbling cascade?

title: Stone cold compulsions
lines: Sight muddied in cocktails and cauldrons,
Smokes from the furnace of buried unearthing,
Embers eclipsing ashes on berated battlefields,
Burning effigies of self-idols made of paper,
Waning on waivers of wills not passed,
Stomach full of morbid undigested faces,
Lift yourself up, look into the shining gleam,
Look up at yourself, flex not fabricated frenzies.

title: Summers of buried graves
lines: Nostalgic winds carry smell of the dead,
Lost embers, lost perspectives, lost lives,
Remembrance buried in graves of apathy,
Bipolar magnitudes creating flux of bias,
Intricate complexity mapping out phases of
The past credence and lost favors,
Apple of the eyes infested with maggots,
Who am I? What am I being in the moment?

title: Building blocks of suppression
lines: Weed vibrant growing out of concrete crevices,
Constriction worries not the planted flowers
Withering with sunlight and care,
Born holding a silver spoon, hands shake
When nothing to hold onto, who teaches to
Let be? Burying in the avalanche of thoughts,

title: Bubbling brook
lines: Snatching strangers in the face of recognition,
Eclipsing thoughts overlaying and cornered,
Trusting and unsuspecting eyes beaming,
Look at him, here, speaking and stuttering
What peace do you hide behind? When the
Truth bleeds in mirages of hemorrhages,
Intent on malarkey, mangling significance,
With biased jumps of jigsaw pieces, mind,
Still keep the people you knew aside,
After riding on shoulders, side by side,
Spit, cough and weave, stay alive,
Blinded by the light shone by your mind.

title: Falls down
lines: Cigarette ashes on his bed, fluttering feckless
And tumbleweeds impede like hails of specks,
Specks with dreams of life, inscribed in the
Winds of the ways none too bereaved,
Just breathe and see, the life bleeding like
The heart pelted with malice of a brickstone,
Breathe and see the ways forgone, your will’s
Voice silenced no more, inner eye turns outside.

title: Vortex of punity
lines: Egotistic breathing, thoughts streaking walls
Of caves to paint shadows of the antiquated,
Eyes see serpents not shadows, waiting
In the dark crevices of contemplation,
Confessions in moments of depravity,
Whispered close by to eyes of stone
Neglected in privilege and self-reduction,
The pat on my father’s back passed down
To these hands, who do they trust?
Beg forgiveness, as you see into eyes of the mind, mumbling, snickering with malicious
Maudlin mirage, flexing fiddling frames
Of smiles lost in paradoxical navigation,
Venturing venomous veins of delusion,
The lungs keep pumping, the breath keeps rushing, pits keep sweating, dread creeping,
Trauma leaking, mind’s shrieking, stares,
Step back, breathing a break back in.
Further rushing, belligerent tributaries of tripe,
Pollute passions, staining its garments,
Turpentine, turgid bodies of succumbing,
Navigate one step at a time, one breath,
Forgive and forget, breathe and see,
Let go off the accelerator, axled wrong,
Loosening grips, patterns forming in cognition,

title: Dichotomy of diuresis
lines: Reverse the magic, masochistic marauds,
Free finally from reigns of reflection,
Antelope tears morph into crocodile’s,
Hypocrisy, heresy hereditary in hieroglyphics
Of civilizations encumbered to tales of truth,
Patience palpitating, tugs of war turning
Tables and tremors of terrible trances,
Appear shining beckoning answers,
Unavoidable indefatigability or free will?
Change yet same, with every moment consider

title: Forbidden fruit
lines: Apple of the eyes, universal depths unraveling,
Snakes of warmth writhing in coddled dreams,
Bite into lush evergreen infathomable,
Hope or despair to pull on heart’s strings,
Self inflicted noose, breathe in and drop,
Effigies of self, egregious peculiarities,
Weather through the crests and troughs of
Companionship complete, care, love
Defined in deliberation’s ecstasy, take
Time, breathe, hand in your hand.

title: Death to remember
lines: Seeds of change sown last year sprout anew,
Recurring cycle of ash and tilling, toiling
Turbulent visions of tyrannical treachery,
Veins pulsating, bloating, life of its own,
Apple fell not far, fathoming vineyards,
Bereft and dilapidated vision of future seen,
Conquered or turned away another fallacy?
See the mistakes of ancestors strewn in
Serendipitous avatars of evading wills,
Remembrance, gratefulness, amalgamation
Of prayers, wishes and same ol’ habits,
Apple fell not far, can see the same worms
Writhing, laying foundations for next nascent
Beings of bubbling bucolic blabbering?
Pass on the baton, hope far, reach out
See it in myself and my others, reaching
reigns of control convoluted on calusses
Cumbersome to come out of, entangling,
Apple fell not far, or vines of hippocampus?
Vines of revered visions reverberating,
Deciphering patterns in eyes of life?
Dreams of Arrakis, poisoned prunes in
Pursuit of actualizing dunes, seeing
Backwards, going forwards in binaries,
Apple fell not far, wine tore the barrel,
Dichotomous hypocrisy unraveling before
The greatness, the misery of the fool?

title: Trembling tree of truth
lines: Definitions misguided and misunderstood,
Same wishes wistful and winked away,
Transforming in tides of time untamed,
See the fallacy of fulsome tirades,
Love and hate on the edge of hereditary
Necessity, incompetence, expression, art!
Trembled knees weathered, trepidates trauma,
Scathing takedowns of self, taken not given,
Hallucinating in anachronism, in three
Generations gone, going, go, where’s the
Son, you? Dreaming draped delusions of
Demented deliberation of dynasty.
The Abrupt Opening
